recognize_zh: CD20 染色可見一個巨大、形狀不規則的 B 細胞結節佔據大部分視野，內部深淺斑駁，左下與右上另有小而完整的 CD20 陽性濾泡作為對照，符合 PTGC。
features: Large, irregular CD20-positive B-cell nodule occupying most of the field
Heterogeneous staining with denser rims and lighter internal zones reflecting admixed mantle cells and germinal center remnants
Several small, round, normal-sized CD20-positive follicles at the lower left and upper/lower right
CD20-negative interfollicular T-zone surrounding the nodule
Fibrous capsule with vessels at the right edge; cleft artifacts present
describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry shows a large, irregularly shaped B-cell nodule with heterogeneous staining intensity, in which dense collections of small CD20-positive B cells alternate with lighter zones. Several small, normal-sized follicles are present nearby, and the interfollicular areas are largely CD20-negative, preserving nodal compartmentalization. Findings support an expanded B-cell nodule consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers, in correlation with IgD and CD10 staining.

ddx.vs: NLPHL nodules contain scattered large CD20+ LP cells rimmed by PD-1+ T cells and usually replace most of the node, whereas PTGC is a focal nodule among reactive follicles without LP cells.
Follicular lymphoma shows diffuse crowding of similar-sized neoplastic follicles with CD10/BCL2 co-expression rather than a single giant nodule adjacent to small reactive follicles.
